title: 14 Day Southern Kenya Birding Safari
rank_math_title: Southern Kenya Birding Safari: 14 Amazing Days to the Coast
rank_math_desc: Southern Kenya birding safari for 14 days: Amboseli, Tsavo West, Taita Hills, Arabuko-Sokoke, Mida Creek, Sabaki, Tsavo East and Chyulu Hills. Price on request.
post_content: This southern Kenya birding safari links Kilimanjaro's elephants, the Taita Hills endemics and the coastal forests in one two-week route.
overview:
This southern Kenya birding safari follows the road from Nairobi to the Indian Ocean and back, visiting some of the most interesting birding sites in the country. It combines classic game parks with rare forest birds and coastal waders.

Highlights include the critically endangered Taita thrush and Taita white-eye, the Sokoke scops owl in Arabuko-Sokoke and crab plovers at Mida Creek.

Why choose this southern Kenya birding safari?

  • Amboseli: elephants below Kilimanjaro and swamp birds.
  • Tsavo West: dry-country birds around Kilaguni.
  • Taita Hills: Taita thrush, Taita white-eye and Taita apalis.
  • Arabuko-Sokoke and Mida Creek: Clarke's weaver, Amani sunbird and crab plovers.
  • Tsavo East and Chyulu Hills: big red elephants and highland forest.

Where you stay

Nairobi Safari Club, Ol Tukai Lodge in Amboseli, Kilaguni Serena Lodge in Tsavo West, a lodge near the Taita Hills, Turtle Bay Beach Club in Watamu, Tsavo Park Hotel and Hunter's Lodge at Kiboko, or similar.

Best time for a southern Kenya birding safari

September to April brings migrant waders to the coast and migrant songbirds inland. June to October is dry, with excellent game viewing in Amboseli and Tsavo.

Prefer just the coast? See our 9 day Kenya coast birding safari. Browse all birding safaris or Kenya safaris. The Taita Hills are a priority site for Nature Kenya.

faq.q: What are the Taita Hills endemics?
faq.a: The Taita thrush, Taita white-eye and Taita apalis live only in the small forest patches of the Taita Hills in southern Kenya.

faq.q: Is the southern Kenya birding safari good for big game?
faq.a: Yes. Amboseli and Tsavo have large elephant herds, lions and buffaloes, and Tsavo East is famous for red-dusted elephants.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Arrival in Nairobi
itinerary.content: Airport pick-up, a visit to the National Museum bird gallery and a walk in the botanic garden. Overnight at Nairobi Safari Club.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Nairobi to Amboseli
itinerary.content: Drive south to Amboseli with a game drive on arrival. Overnight at Ol Tukai Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Full day in Amboseli
itinerary.content: Birding with your guide around the swamps and plains, and photos of Kilimanjaro at dawn.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Amboseli to Tsavo West
itinerary.content: Game drive to Tsavo West and lunch at Kilaguni Serena Lodge. Afternoon birding around the lodge waterhole.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Taita Hills
itinerary.content: Visit the forest patches of the Taita Hills for Taita thrush, Taita white-eye and Taita apalis. Overnight at a lodge near the hills.

itinerary.label: Day 6
itinerary.title: Taita Hills to Watamu
itinerary.content: Drive to the coast and check in at Turtle Bay Beach Club for five nights.

itinerary.label: Day 7
itinerary.title: Arabuko-Sokoke Forest
itinerary.content: A full day for Clarke's weaver, Amani sunbird, Sokoke pipit and the Sokoke scops owl.

itinerary.label: Day 8
itinerary.title: Arabuko-Sokoke Forest
itinerary.content: Another forest day for ant-eater thrush, Mombasa woodpecker and eastern nicator.

itinerary.label: Day 9
itinerary.title: Mida Creek
itinerary.content: Bird the mangroves and tidal flats for crab plovers, terek sandpipers and mangrove kingfishers.

itinerary.label: Day 10
itinerary.title: Sabaki River mouth
itinerary.content: Drive north of Malindi to the Sabaki estuary for terns, gulls, Malindi pipit and waders.

itinerary.label: Day 11
itinerary.title: Watamu to Tsavo East
itinerary.content: Drive inland to Tsavo East National Park. Overnight at Tsavo Park Hotel.

itinerary.label: Day 12
itinerary.title: Tsavo East to Kibwezi
itinerary.content: Morning game drive in Tsavo East, then on to Kibwezi Forest. Overnight at Hunter's Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 13
itinerary.title: Chyulu Hills
itinerary.content: A day in the forest and grasslands of the Chyulu Hills. Overnight at Hunter's Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 14
itinerary.title: Return to Nairobi
itinerary.content: Drive to Nairobi for lunch and a farewell dinner before your flight.
